title: Recover odor-pulse quantity and temporal sensory evidence from anterior piriform spike trains

evidence.supports: Preserved original source registration, source citations and proposed complete scientific endpoint; later implementation corrections are distinguished below.
Complete delivered target/split/cohort, fixed-reference engineering evidence and participant-boundary limits.
Deposited target admission, physical-primary refusal, exact complete-coverage metrics.
Frozen 43-session/2199 query profile and exact accepted artifact identities.
Whole original Parquet route and preserved native-conversion lineage, without claiming new-host execution.

evidence.locator: APCx experiment, reused source review in original and delivered contracts
evidence.supports: Paper scientific question and reported 42-session assay, distinct from inspected 43-session deposited release.
Actual reference execution entrypoint and complete preparation/assembly/scoring commands; explicitly no candidate process launched.
One-session observation and complete return-schema validators; no participant loop or tool controller.
Executable fixed session-local mean/count/temporal reference mathematics with train-only normalization and prescribed alpha grid.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: Accepted complete selected-host fixed-reference engineering results are retained. No new reference rerun, candidate/model trial or human result occurred in this revision.
excluded_claims: Ridge programme performance establishes unaided neural understanding
Portable source alone requalifies a new host

disposition_reason: Delivered source evaluates deposited Total_pulse labels on the complete 43-session release, not the original physical-event target or paper-reported 42-session roster. This revision names that conditional endpoint without removing unresolved physical/QC/chronology holds.

scientific_target.question: How accurately can session-calibrated APCx spike counts predict the deposited full-window Total_pulse label, and what information is added by temporal patterns over total spikes?
scientific_target.known_answer: Integer Total_pulse deposited with each retained trial; optional low/high category is derived as <=8 versus >=9.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Byte-pinned canonical Figshare Parquet and complete owner-side conversion, with physical-delivery verification explicitly false. The deposited label is not proven equivalent to a physical odor-valve event count.
scientific_target.case_unit: One released trial with all retained session units over 90 50-ms bins from 0.5 to 5 seconds.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Three mice;43 sessions and session-specific units/trials are nested, not independent animals.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Within-session interpolation on historically selected released recordings under target-blind hash split; temporal-versus-count decoder comparison concerns predictive information, not an accumulator mechanism.
exclusions: Physical full 5-second pulse-event count qualification remains held.
No chronological forecasting, unseen-animal transfer or all-quality-passing-neuron population claim.
The first 500 ms is unobserved, not zero-filled signal.

inputs: Integer spike counts for every released session unit in 90 fixed 50 ms bins [0.5,5), opaque session/case IDs and identical condition documentation.
Matched condition supplies first 16 calibration and 8 development trials in frozen hash ordering per session; full_calibration supplies all calibration/development rows, separately reported.
forbidden_inputs: Total_pulse/high-low query labels, physical-command diagnostics, pulse times, reward/choice, source identities, authentic session dates and other-session/condition data.
Owner packets, private HMAC key, source Parquet, notebook outputs, hidden-score feedback or snippets aligned to unknown individual pulses.
observation_contract.case_identity: Opaque HMAC-bound IDs; task.py episodes writes one file per session and condition, response identities bind packet and episode digests. Complete public source includes schemas but no authentic packets.
observation_contract.split: Delivered deterministic target-blind hash split within session, not original chronological 60/20/20 proposal. All views of a trial stay together; no development refit in accepted reference panel.
observation_contract.coverage: 95,072 deposited rows,10,831 trials,43 sessions,383 session-unit pairs,3 mice;2,199 protected queries per condition. Retain all 900 physically unresolved trials including 165 queries;86 session-condition episodes are conditions of one registration.

primary.name: Animal-macro RMSE of deposited Total_pulse
primary.aggregation: Compute RMSE across every protected trial of each mouse, then equal mean of three mouse RMSEs. Clip finite negative predictions at zero; no upper clip or rounding.
primary.rationale: Preserves complete released label target while avoiding trial-rich animals dominating the headline score.

secondary: All 43 session and 3 animal RMSE/MAE, animal-macro MAE and pooled descriptive metrics.
R-squared explicitly undefined for constant targets; low/high balanced accuracy and log loss only with a complete optional probability column.
Prespecified temporal-minus-total-spike, temporal-minus-mean and total-spike-minus-mean paired contrasts, separately in matched and full_calibration conditions.

comparators.name: Calibration mean
comparators.inputs: Current session/condition permitted calibration labels only
comparators.procedure: Implemented fixed baseline; no neural input.

comparators.name: Total-spike ridge
comparators.inputs: All units total spikes in [0.5,5), same support labels
comparators.procedure: Implemented calibration-only mean/scale, seven-alpha grid 0.0001..100, development MSE selects alpha with largest-alpha tie rule; no development refit.

comparators.name: 90-bin temporal ridge
comparators.inputs: All 90 bins/all retained units, identical session/condition labels
comparators.procedure: Implemented same seven-alpha selection and fitting rules; compared on exact same protected trials.

nuisance_controls: Historical unit/QC selection and unknown original exclusions may enrich decodable neurons; do not relabel this as all-QC population decoding.
Do not use command-derived sniff histograms or pulse masks as stimulus-blind inputs.
Retain 43-session release versus 42-session paper discrepancy,900 unresolved physical trials and missing chronology beside results.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report all three mice and 43 sessions with paired fixed-reference differences. Missing original chronology prevents the original proposed contiguous-trial bootstrap from supporting a temporal uncertainty claim; three animals do not support broad population precision. Existing optional bootstrap source is not an accepted reference-operation result.
evaluation.failure_policy: All 86 responses and every 2,199 query per condition must match episode/packet identity exactly before owner labels are opened. Extra/missing/duplicate/replayed responses or invalid counts refuse complete aggregate; unresolved physical trials are not removed.

implementation.scorer_target: grader.grade_values requires deposited_Total_pulse_label and physical_delivery_verified=false, and scores complete within-session deposited-label predictions. evaluate_physical_primary only returns the unchanged physical-primary holds.
implementation.delivered_scope: Official-input conversion, authenticated prepared-packet provision,86 target-free episode files, complete response assembly and scoring source; fixed mean/count/temporal reference panel. Candidate process isolation is external.
missing: Physical command-delivery/overlap provenance, all-QC roster, original chronology/exclusion and compiler-to-file lineage.
Portable new-host runtime/native parity and externally enforced one-episode participant mounting/lifecycle.
Any direct or viewer model study and qualification of explanation/accumulation claims.
implementation.execution_evidence: Published component records an accepted selected-host whole-cohort native operation and all 86 fixed-reference episodes,13,194 reference predictions and 1,204 normal-equation systems. Those are authentic fixed-reference engineering evidence, not an LLM trial, new-host certification or physical-target qualification.

direct_observation.representation: Prepared target-free numeric session episodes exist, containing the complete 90-bin signals and permitted support; a no-tools participant controller is not supplied.
direct_observation.boundary: A no-execution participant could consume the episode only after capacity/fresh-context controls; episode source itself does not enforce no tools.
missing: Matched complete-context serialization and actual no-tools transport/model trial.
Actual direct-answer or per-case investigator controller; the shipped CLI prepares episodes and consumes results but launches no candidate.

typed_viewer.representation: Possible raster/count heatmap view of all retained units and 90 bins; no current typed renderer.
typed_viewer.boundary: Must preserve complete observation and cannot reveal physical-command diagnostic overlays.
missing: Typed actions, complete rendering and answer protocol.

tool_assisted.representation: Prepared one-session evidence and a fixed numerical reference kernel exist; no per-case investigator loop or tool-calling controller is supplied.
tool_assisted.boundary: Mount one episode only, fixed same-support tooling/compute, no owner targets/other sessions; this source does not enforce an LLM sandbox.
missing: Externally enforced case/session state isolation and investigator run.
Actual direct-answer or per-case investigator controller; the shipped CLI prepares episodes and consumes results but launches no candidate.

frozen_program.representation: Actual task.py reference entrypoint runs the precommitted calibration-mean, count-ridge and temporal-ridge numerical procedures on one authenticated session episode; it is not an arbitrary candidate launcher.
frozen_program.boundary: The fixed reference CLI executes only the shipped mean/ridge panel. Complete candidate prediction validation is an operator scoring route, not a candidate executable lifecycle or external predictor callback.
missing: New-host frozen lifecycle and any candidate capability study.
A genuine candidate executable/predictor lifecycle with frozen input scope and captured complete outputs. Fixed reference or negative-control source alone is insufficient.

summary: Promote the actual deposited-label endpoint to the named current delivered scope while preserving the original physical primary as unresolved lineage.
Correct actual cohort to 43 released sessions and delivered hash split, distinguishing the paper 42-session and chronological proposals.
Bind fixed references,2,199 complete queries per condition and authentic engineering evidence without inventing model trials.
Access-source audit distinguishes owner-side episode preparation and concrete fixed-reference execution from missing participant controllers for direct, investigator and candidate-program modes.
Fixed reference/negative-control execution is recorded as comparator capability, not a delivered frozen participant mode.
revision.source_review: Reviewed preserved scientific registration and named implementation code/documentation; reused cited primary source evidence already verified in these records. No scientific arrays or evaluator labels were opened in this revision.
